examPattern: Written Examination / Screening Test followed by Document Verification or Interview

topics: Sections 1–2 (Short title, commencement, application, Definitions)
Sections 3–13 (Types of punishment, commutation, fines, solitary confinement, enhanced punishment after previous conviction, etc.)
Sections 14–44 (Acts done by mistake of fact, judicial acts, accidents, acts of children/unsound mind persons, consent, private defence, etc.)

units.unitTitle: CHAPTER IV – OF ABETMENT, CRIMINAL CONSPIRACY AND ATTEMPT TO COMMIT OFFENCES
topics: Sections 45–62 (Abetment, abettors, criminal conspiracy, attempt to commit offences)

units.unitTitle: CHAPTER VII – OFFENCES AGAINST THE STATE
topics: Sections 147–158 (Waging war against the Government of India, acts endangering sovereignty/unity/integrity of India, offences relating to prisoners of state/war, etc.)

units.unitTitle: CHAPTER XII – OF OFFENCES BY OR RELATING TO PUBLIC SERVANTS
topics: Sections 198–205 (Public servant disobeying law, framing incorrect documents, unlawfully engaging in trade, personating a public servant, etc.)

units.unitTitle: CHAPTER XIII – OF CONTEMPT OF THE LAWFUL AUTHORITY OF PUBLIC SERVANTS
topics: Sections 206–226 (Absconding to avoid summons, non-attendance, refusing to answer/sign, false statement on oath, threats to public servants, etc.)

units.unitTitle: CHAPTER XIV – OF FALSE EVIDENCE AND OFFENCES AGAINST PUBLIC JUSTICE
topics: Sections 227–269 (Giving/fabricating false evidence, harbouring offenders, false charges, escape from custody, failure to appear on bail, etc.)

units.unitTitle: CHAPTER XV – OF OFFENCES AFFECTING PUBLIC HEALTH, SAFETY, CONVENIENCE, DECENCY AND MORALS
topics: Sections 270–297 (Public nuisance, adulteration of food/drugs, rash driving, negligent conduct with fire/explosives/machinery, obscenity, lottery offices, etc.)
Sections 303–334 (Theft, extortion, robbery, dacoity, criminal breach of trust, cheating, mischief, criminal trespass and house-trespass, etc.)

units.unitTitle: CHAPTER XVIII – OF OFFENCES RELATING TO DOCUMENTS AND TO PROPERTY MARKS
topics: Sections 335–350 (Forgery, false documents, counterfeit seals/marks, falsification of accounts, property marks, etc.)
